sections.html:
Clearfield is a compact city in north-central Davis County, about 30 miles north of Salt Lake City, with Hill Air Force Base along its northeastern edge. It covers roughly 7.75 square miles. Sunset lies north, Clinton northwest, Syracuse and West Point west, and Layton wraps the south and east.

The streets run on a grid across flat ground, from about 4,314 feet at 1000 West and Antelope Drive to 4,711 feet in the northeast corner on base property. The Weber and Davis Canal runs along the east and northeast edge, and Interstate 15 follows the eastern side of town. Because the city is small, many houses are a short drive from the base gates, the Freeport Center and the freeway, and buyers ask about that first.

sections.h2: Hill Air Force Base and the local market
sections.html:
The base borders Clearfield, Layton, Riverdale, Roy and Sunset, with its longest border shared with Clearfield and Layton. It is Davis County's largest employer, with nearly 23,000 military and civilian personnel, and it accounts for about 12 percent of the county's economy. The 75th Air Base Wing hosts the Ogden Air Logistics Complex, the 388th and 419th Fighter Wings and more than 50 other units.

For a seller, that means a steady pool of local buyers and renters. It also means the occasional sudden move when someone gets orders and has little time to prepare a house. The Freeport Center, a 680-acre complex of 78 buildings with about 70 companies and roughly 7,000 workers, adds more local jobs. Two newer business areas, Legend Hills off I-15 and the planned Falcon Hill aerospace area, point to more aerospace work nearby.

sections.h2: Older houses and what buyers check
sections.html:
Much of the city's growth came after World War II. Population went from 982 in 1940 to 4,723 in 1950 and was 31,909 in 2020, so a good share of the houses are several decades old. Expect a mid-century house to draw questions about original kitchens, baths, electrical panels and plumbing.

The area gets about 20.75 inches of precipitation and about 24 inches of snow a year. Winter inversions can trap heavy air pollution along this part of the Wasatch Front, so buyers may care about filters and furnace condition. The Wasatch Fault runs along the western base of the mountains, and the Utah Division of Emergency Management warns that older unreinforced masonry buildings face greater risk in a strong quake.

  • Furnace, filters and ductwork on 1950s and 1960s homes
  • Brick chimneys and masonry porches
  • Roof age after years of snow load
  • Drainage and grading on lots near the Weber and Davis Canal

A FrontRunner commuter rail stop opened in Clearfield in 2008, and Davis County counts the city among its station cities, alongside Woods Cross, Farmington and Layton. Interstate 15 is the other main route. Clearfield High School, North Davis Junior High and elementary schools such as South Clearfield, Hill Field and Holt are in the Davis School District.

sections.h2: How Davis County bills Clearfield property tax
sections.html:
Davis County sends the bill, and payment is due November 30. When that date falls on a weekend, the treasurer moves it to the next business day, December 1 or December 2 depending on the calendar.

Ways to pay a Davis County property tax bill
Payment methodHow it works
OnlineForte bill pay at billpay.forte.net/davisuttax, with card or electronic check
Phone(877) 690-3729, jurisdiction code 5450
MailP.O. Box 618, Farmington, UT 84025-0618, timely if postmarked by the due date
PrepayMonthly coupon or ACH payments from January to September

Card payments carry a fee that goes to the card company. Electronic checks do not. After November 30 the penalty is the greater of $10 or 2.5 percent per parcel, falling to the greater of $10 or 1 percent if you pay in full by January 31. Interest of 7.25 to 10 percent follows after that.

Utah Code 59-2-103 gives residential property a 45 percent reduction in value, so a primary residence is taxed on 55 percent. Rental houses do not get it unless the tenant lives there as a primary residence, so Clearfield landlords often see a higher bill.

The title company divides the year's tax bill between you and the buyer by the closing date. Ask for that proration in writing. If your lender has been paying the tax from escrow, confirm that, since the county notes that third-party services can be slow to post payments.

  1. Pull your latest Davis County tax notice.
  2. Confirm whether a lender escrow account pays it.
  3. Give the notice and payoff details to the title company.
  4. Check the proration line on the closing statement.

sections.h2: What does a quick sale look like for a Clearfield seller?
sections.html:
Clearfield sellers often own a mid-century house with deferred updates, a rental that has run its course, or a home they must sell quickly because of a job or military move. A cash sale closes on a date you choose and skips the repair requests that come with a lender's appraisal. The path is simple: you describe the house, take or decline an offer, and a title company handles the search and paperwork.

  • Houses with original kitchens, baths, electrical panels and plumbing
  • Rentals where tenants have moved out and left repairs
  • Homes owned by someone who has relocated for work
  • Inherited property with several heirs and no clear plan

Base assignments can change fast, and orders rarely arrive on a seller's timeline. If you are in that spot, tell the buyer your move date at the start so it can be built into the closing schedule.

faqs.q: Which county is Clearfield, Utah in?
faqs.a: Davis County. The treasurer's office in Farmington bills the property tax, and its phone number is 801-451-3243.

faqs.q: What is the property tax due date in Clearfield?
faqs.a: November 30. If that is a weekend, the due date moves to the next business day, and penalties start after that day.

faqs.q: What is the Freeport Center in Clearfield?
faqs.a: A 680-acre manufacturing and distribution complex on the former Clearfield Naval Supply Depot, with 78 buildings, about 70 companies and roughly 7,000 workers.

faqs.q: Does Hill Air Force Base affect Clearfield housing?
faqs.a: Yes. The base is next door and is Davis County's largest employer, with nearly 23,000 personnel, so many local homes are bought and sold by people tied to it.

faqs.q: Can I sell a Clearfield house that needs repairs?
faqs.a: Yes. Houses can sell as they are, with repairs left undone. Tell the buyer about the roof, heating, plumbing and electrical so terms are clear before closing.
